title: Binary Tree Right Side View
inputFormat: Implement rightSideView(root). The runner converts the level-order input array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: An array containing the rightmost node at each depth, from top to bottom. Return [] for an empty tree.

visuals.title: The visible node can come from the left subtree
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 255" role="img" aria-label="Root 1 has children 2 and 3; node 2 has left child 4; the right-side view is 1, 3, 4" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M190 30L95 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M190 30L285 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M95 105L45 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="190" cy="30" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="190" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">1</text><circle cx="95" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="95" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">2</text><circle cx="285" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="285" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">3</text><circle cx="45" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="45" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">4</text><text x="190" y="220" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">Right-side view: [1, 3, 4]</text></svg>
visuals.caption: In this additional example, node 4 is visible because there is no node to its right at that depth.
